question: Should this PR keep the Telegram scoped UI override and cron no-delivery wake change together, or should the cron behavior be split before merge?
rationale: The generated metadata blocker is mechanical, but the PR also changes cron wake semantics without separate real proof, so maintainer intent is needed for the combined product surface.

options.title: Keep together after proof
options.body: Require generated metadata plus positive Telegram and cron proof, then review the combined behavior as one PR.

options.title: Split cron behavior
options.body: Land a refreshed Telegram-only PR first and move main-session no-delivery wake suppression into a separate reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave this branch unmerged if the contributor cannot provide generated metadata and real behavior proof for the combined surface.

recommendation.title: Keep together after proof
recommendation.body: Require generated metadata plus positive Telegram and cron proof, then review the combined behavior as one PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest history trail ties steipete to the config metadata architecture and recent current-main touches, making them the best available owner for the merge-risk direction.
